pages.text: Timer: $(thing)30 min$() in Normal, $(thing)25$() in Nightmare, $(thing)20$() in Chaos. It shows at the top of the screen and in the $(l:extras/hud)HUD$().$(br2)To get out: go back through the $(item)arrival portal$(), or activate the $(item)destination mechanism$() (stay 5 s next to it) to open an exit deeper in.
Stay next to it for 5 seconds to open the destination room's exit portal.
pages.title: Destination

pages.text: Inside the Sanctum, $(thing)Survival$() is forced. You can $(good)place blocks$() but not break them.$(br2)$(bad)Forbidden$(): buckets, pistons, TNT, beds, ender chests, tools on dungeon blocks.$(br2)Nobody can enter during the last minute.
pages.title: Rules
